Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient

Class WebclientApi

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.WebclientApi
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class WebclientApi extends Object implements AutoCloseable
API to communicate with a OMERO.web server.

This API is mainly used to keep a connection alive, log out, perform a search and get OMERO annotations.

An instance of this class must be closed once no longer used.

  • Constructor Details

    • WebclientApi

      public WebclientApi(URI webServerUri, RequestSender requestSender, String token) throws URISyntaxException
      Creates a web client.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URL to the OMERO web server to connect to
      requestSender - the request sender to use when making requests
      token - the CSRF token used by this session. This is needed to properly close this API
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException - if the ping URI cannot be created

  • Method Details

    • close

      public void close() throws URISyntaxException, ExecutionException, InterruptedException
      Close the connection by sending a login out request. This may take a moment as it waits for the request to complete.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException - when the login out request URI is invalid
      ExecutionException - when the request failed
      InterruptedException - when the wait for the request to end was interrupted

    • ping

      public CompletableFuture<Void> ping()
      Attempt to send a ping to the server. This is needed to keep the connection alive between the client and the server.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the ping fails)

    • getPublicUserId

      public CompletableFuture<Long> getPublicUserId()
      Attempt to get the ID of the public user of the server.

      This only works if there is no active authenticated connection with the server. If that's not the case, an unexpected value will be returned.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request or the conversion failed for example).

      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the public user ID

    • getAnnotations

      public CompletableFuture<List<Annotation>> getAnnotations(SimpleServerEntity entity)
      Attempt to retrieve OMERO annotations of an OMERO entity. An OMERO annotation is not similar to a QuPath annotation, it refers to some metadata attached to an entity.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      entity - the entity whose annotation should be retrieved
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the annotation group

      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with a list of search results

    • sendKeyValuePairs

      public CompletableFuture<Void> sendKeyValuePairs(long imageId, Namespace namespace, Map<String,String> keyValues, boolean replaceExisting)
      Send key-value pairs associated with an image to the OMERO server.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      imageId - the id of the image to associate the key value pairs
      namespace - the OMERO namespace the key-value pairs should have on the OMERO server
      keyValues - the key value pairs to send
      replaceExisting - whether to replace values when keys already exist on the OMERO server
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)

    • sendAttachment

      public CompletableFuture<Void> sendAttachment(SimpleServerEntity entity, String attachmentName, String attachmentContent)
      Send a file to be attached to a server entity.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      entity - the entity the file should be attached to
      attachmentName - the name of the file to send. A prefix will be added to it to mark this file as coming from QuPath
      attachmentContent - the content of the file to send
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)

    • deleteAttachments

      public CompletableFuture<Void> deleteAttachments(SimpleServerEntity entity, List<Long> experimenterIds)
      Delete attachments belonging to a list of users added from QuPath of an OMERO entity.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      entity - the entity whose attachments should be deleted
      experimenterIds - the IDs of the experimenters that should own the attachments to remove. If one provided ID is less than or equal to 0, all attachments added from QuPath of the provided image are deleted
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)
